verified_rule: Only atomic FACT with directly relevant first-party exact text, dated application or explicit scope, all material conditions and exceptions, and documented model reasoning can be VERIFIED. A search result, issuer URL, raw SHA or keyword match alone cannot establish claim entailment.
question_rule: Source questions are NOT_FACT_CLAIM. A questioner's false premise can be corrected from official source but must never be counted as a speaker factual assertion.
nonfactual_rule: Forecast, valuation opinion, personal recommendation and hypothetical modeling must not be marked VERIFIED as historical legal facts. Record them separately with assumptions and limits.
contradiction_rule: Conflicting primary-source evidence must be documented CONTRADICTED, not silently counted verified. Release prevents any unresolved critical contradiction.
completeness_rule: Report 1) total source factual atoms, 2) official-verifiable atoms, 3) first-party VERIFIED, 4) CONTRADICTED, 5) UNVERIFIED, 6) correctly segregated questions/hypotheticals/opinions, 7) uncategorized/unreviewed and source-window coverage. All material tax/pension/leverage/return facts must have safe resolution before scope completion.
status_by_evidence: The source rule may be VERIFIED without a human reviewer. Original-video speaker claim is only VERIFIED once source quote+proposition+semantic relationship is explicitly checked; archived government text by itself is not a verified video claim.
temporal_guard: An original official HTML capture verifies content of that historical response, not future/current law. For date-sensitive rules check law effective_from <= claim_as_of and effective_to or later overrides; missing NTS publication date must be explicitly UNKNOWN.
legacy_policy: 116 original protected claim records never changed. Same-topic is not SAME relation without actual text comparison. Relation statuses OPEN/SAME/EXTENDS/CONFLICT/SUPERSEDED/DISTINCT must be source-supported.
score: Keep previous 60/100 evidence management baseline unchanged on policy update. Replace human-review remaining C gate with comprehensive official-source checked claim census, explicit high-risk resolution and coverage/omission/conflict audit, not statistical precision/recall.
